# YieldGuard

> YieldGuard (yieldguard.health) provides hospital price transparency compliance: automated auditing and remediation of CMS machine-readable files under 45 CFR Part 180.

## Pages
- [Yield Guard Health - Hospital Price Transparency Compliance](https://yieldguard.health/): Automated auditing and remediation for 45 CFR Part 180: price transparency compliance for hospitals.
- [Yield Guard Health - Managed Compliance Capabilities | Hospital Price Transparency](https://yieldguard.health/features): Managed CMS price transparency compliance capabilities: code resolution, continuous monitoring and an audit-ready evidence locker.
- [Yield Guard Health - Hospital Price Transparency Compliance | Pricing & Plans](https://yieldguard.health/pricing): Pricing and plans for hospital price transparency compliance, from community hospitals to enterprise health systems.
- [Yield Guard Health - Hospital Price Transparency Compliance | About Our Mission & Team](https://yieldguard.health/about): About Yield Guard Health: our mission, team and beliefs.
- [Yield Guard Health - Hospital Price Transparency Compliance | Careers & Founding Team Roles](https://yieldguard.health/careers): Join the Yield Guard Health founding team. Remote-first, mission-driven.
- [Yield Guard Health - Hospital Price Transparency Compliance | Contact & Support](https://yieldguard.health/contact): Contact Yield Guard Health for price transparency compliance support.
- [Yield Guard Health - MRF & Compliance Glossary](https://yieldguard.health/mrf-compliance-glossary): Glossary of CMS hospital price transparency, MRF, regulatory, data quality and payer terms.
